units.text: Atuin replaces your existing shell history with a SQLite database, and records additional context for your commands.
units.raw_slice:
Atuin replaces your existing shell history with a SQLite database, and records
additional context for your commands.

units.text: Additionally, it provides optional and fully encrypted synchronisation of your history between machines, via an Atuin server.

Additionally, it provides optional and
_fully encrypted_ synchronisation of your history between machines, via an Atuin
server.
